primary_source_applied.citation: Livshyts--Paouris--Pivovarov, On sharp bounds for marginal densities of product measures, Israel J. Math. 216 (2016), arXiv:1507.07949
primary_source_applied.use: two-dimensional orthogonal projection density cap M<=2

mathematical_change.statement: If X has density cap 1, Y in R^2 is independent of X with arbitrary joint density cap M, and H=[[0,ell^T],[ell,B]] is symmetric nonsingular, then (X,Y)^T H(X,Y) has a continuous density bounded by 6 M^(2/3)|det H|^(-1/3).
mathematical_change.application: Partner zero-pivot rank-one-deletion and rank-two-deletion cases close with universal bound 6*2^(2/3)<9.525 under the target exact-rank-three spectral normalization.
